subject: general
question: Tooth decay is caused by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bacteria.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The decay of teeth is because of the increase in acidity inside the mouth due to** bacteria.**
 
• The tooth decay starts in the mouth when the **ph goes below 5.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A healthy pH for the mouth environment is nearly neutral at 6.8. 
 
• Tooth erosion occurs primarily due to acids you ingest from outside sources, such as sodas and citrus fruit drinks.
 
• The enamel is composed of 96% minerals, primarily hydroxyapatite; the remaining 4% of the enamel is primarily water and organic material.
